words.ex: This song is popular with teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很受欢迎。
words.en: If someone or something is popular with a particular group of people, they are liked or admired by those people.

words.tr: phrase. 具有，拥有（某种品质、能力或特征）
words.ex: He is possessed of great courage.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有巨大的勇气。
words.en: To have or own something, especially a quality or attribute.

words.tr: phrase. 充满忧虑的；全神贯注于…的；一心想着…的
words.ex_cn: 他整天都心不在焉地想着手机。
words.en: If you are preoccupied with something, you are thinking about it a lot or worrying about it so much that you do not think about other things.

words.tr: phrase. 精通于……的；在……方面熟练的
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To have or show a high level of skill or ability in a particular activity or subject.

words.ex: My mom is proud of me because I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈为我通过考试而感到骄傲。
words.en: To feel a sense of pride or satisfaction in something or someone.

words.ex: He is ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他准备好考试了。
words.en: To be prepared or in a state of readiness for something that is expected to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 不情愿做某事的；勉强的；不愿的
words.ex: He is reluctant to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意在全班面前说话。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: To have the duty of taking care of something or someone, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong.

words.ex: This soil is rich in nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 这种土壤富含养分。
words.en: To contain a large amount of something beneficial or valuable.

words.ex: He is satisfied with his test score.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的考试成绩感到满意。
words.en: To feel content or pleased with something because it meets your expectations or desires.

words.tr: verb phrase. 充满…的；饱含…的；被…浸透的
words.ex: The paper is saturated with too many details.
words.ex_cn: 这篇论文充满了太多细节。
words.en: To be filled with something so that no more can be added; to be thoroughly soaked or imbued with a substance or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到……的；觉察到……的
words.ex_cn: 他意识到自己的错误。
words.en: To be aware of or conscious of something.

words.ex: He is sensitive to loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对大声响很敏感。
words.en: To be easily affected or influenced by something, especially in a way that is not desired.

words.ex: We are short of money to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 我们缺钱买食物。
words.en: If you are short of something, you do not have enough of it. If something is short of a place, it is not as far as that place.

words.tr: phrase. 擅长于……的；在……方面熟练的
words.ex_cn: 他擅长弹吉他。
words.en: To be proficient or adept in a particular activity.

words.tr: phrase. 特定于……的；专门针对……的
words.ex_cn: 这条规则只适用于10岁以下的儿童。
words.en: Relating exclusively or uniquely to a particular thing or situation.

words.ex: My mom is strict with me about homework.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈对我的作业很严格。
words.en: To demand or enforce rules and standards rigorously.

words.tr: phrase. 受支配；从属于；受制；常遭受...
words.ex: He is subject to fines if he breaks the rules.
words.ex_cn: 如果他违反规则，就会被罚款。
words.en: If someone or something is subject to something, especially something bad, it is likely or certain to be affected by it.

words.tr: phrase. 充满，洋溢（常用于情感或光线等抽象事物）
words.ex: The room was suffused with sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 房间里充满了阳光。
words.en: If something such as a book, film, or piece of music is suffused with a particular quality, that quality spreads all through it and is very noticeable in it.

words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

words.tr: phrase. 优越于；胜过；不屈服于
words.ex: This phone is superior to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比那部更好。
words.en: To be better or higher in quality, rank, or status than someone or something else.

words.ex: He is sure of his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他确信自己的答案。
words.en: If you are sure of something, you are confident that it is true or correct.

words.ex: The house is surrounded by tall trees.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子被高大的树木环绕着。
words.en: To be all around someone or something, so that they are enclosed or confined.

words.ex: He is tired of eating the same food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天吃同样的食物。
words.en: To feel that you have had enough of someone or something and do not want to have to deal with them or it any more.

words.tr: phrase. 生活富裕 ；处境良好
words.ex: They are well off because they have a big house and a car.
words.ex_cn: 他们很富裕，因为他们有一栋大房子和一辆车。
words.en: To be in a comfortable financial situation; to have enough money to live well.

words.tr: phrase. 愿意做某事；乐意去做
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If someone is willing to do something, they are ready and eager to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 值得……的；应得某种待遇或评价的
words.ex_cn: 这幅画配得上博物馆。
words.en: To be deserving of something, often due to merit or quality.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: Before long, he will finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 不久之后，他就会完成作业。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or is true before long, you mean that it will happen or is true soon.

words.ex: I believe in working hard to achieve my dreams.
words.ex_cn: 我相信努力工作能实现我的梦想。
words.en: To feel certain that something exists or is true, or to have confidence in a person or thing.

words.ex: Believe it or not, he passed the test without studying.
words.ex_cn: 信不信由你，他没学习就通过了考试。
words.en: Used to introduce a statement that may seem surprising or unbelievable.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.tr: phrase. 难以形容的；无法描述的；超出言语表达的
words.ex: The beauty of the sunset was beyond description.
words.ex_cn: 日落的美景难以形容。
words.en: If you say that something is beyond description, you mean that it is very difficult to describe because it is so extreme or so unusual.

words.tr: phrase. 无法用言语表达的；难以言喻的
words.ex: Her joy was beyond words.
words.ex_cn: 她的喜悦无法用言语表达。
words.en: If something is beyond words, it is impossible to describe it in words.

words.tr: phrase. （价格、价值等）跌至最低点，触底；（经济状况）降至最低水平后趋于稳定
words.ex: The price of oil bottomed out last month.
words.ex_cn: 油价上个月触底了。
words.en: To reach the lowest point or level, after which no further decline occurs.

words.ex: He tried to break away from his old habits.
words.ex_cn: 他试图摆脱旧习惯。
words.en: To leave or escape from a group, place, or situation, especially in order to start something new or different.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.ex: The thief tried to break into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图在夜里闯入房子。
words.en: To enter a building or car using force, in order to steal something; to suddenly start doing something.

words.ex: The fire broke out in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 火在厨房里突然烧了起来。
words.en: If something such as war, fighting, or disease breaks out, it begins suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 打破僵局；缓解紧张气氛；使初次见面的人放松
words.ex: He told a joke to break the ice at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上讲了个笑话来打破僵局。
words.en: To do or say something to relieve tension or get conversation going in a strained situation or when strangers meet.

words.tr: 使……陷入停滞；使……完全停止
words.ex: The snowstorm brought traffic to a standstill.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雪使交通陷入瘫痪。
words.en: To cause something to stop moving or functioning.

words.ex: Hard work can bring about success.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作可以带来成功。
words.en: To cause something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 使表现出；说出；呈出；出版
words.ex: The new lighting really brings out the colors in the painting.
words.ex_cn: 新灯光让画中的颜色更加突出。
words.en: To cause something to be seen or known; to publish something.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （使建筑物等）烧毁；烧成平地
words.ex: The old house burned down in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 那座老房子在火灾中被烧毁了。
words.en: If a building burns down or if someone burns it down, it is completely destroyed by fire.

words.ex: The thieves burst into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷在夜里闯入了房子。
words.en: If you burst into a particular kind of activity, you suddenly start doing it.

words.ex: He broke the vase by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If something happens by accident, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.tr: phrase. 尽一切办法；务必；一定
words.ex: You can borrow my book by all means.
words.ex_cn: 你当然可以借我的书。
words.en: used to give permission or to say that you are willing to allow something to happen

words.tr: phrase. 出生时；天生地；因出生而
words.ex: He is by birth a French citizen.
words.ex_cn: 他生来就是法国公民。
words.en: From the time of one's birth; by natural origin or as a result of one's birth.

words.ex: I met my old friend by chance at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市碰巧遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: If something happens by chance, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.ex: He lives alone by choice.
words.ex_cn: 他独自生活是出于自己的选择。
words.en: If you do something by choice, you do it because you want to do it and not because you are forced to do it.

words.ex: He is slow, by comparison, his brother is fast.
words.ex_cn: 相比之下，他很慢，他弟弟很快。
words.en: When you say that something is true by comparison, you mean that it is true when compared to something else.

words.tr: phrase. 相比之下；对比而言
words.ex: He likes coffee. By contrast, she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡。相比之下，她更喜欢茶。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.tr: phrase. …得多；尤其；更；到目前为止
words.ex: This is by far the best movie I have seen.
words.ex_cn: 这绝对是我看过的最好的电影。
words.en: By far is used to emphasize that something is the best, worst, biggest, etc., of its kind.

words.ex: He cleaned the floor by means of a mop.
words.ex_cn: 他用拖把打扫了地板。
words.en: If you do something by means of a particular method, instrument, or process, you do it using that method, instrument, or process.

words.tr: phrase. 就其本质而言；天生地
words.ex: He is by nature a quiet person.
words.ex_cn: 他天性安静。
words.en: If someone has a particular quality by nature, they have it as a natural part of their character.

words.ex: He is by no means lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对不懒。
words.en: You use 'by no means' to emphasize that something is not true or is definitely not the case.

words.ex: He did the homework by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他独自完成了作业。
words.en: Without help from anyone else; alone.

words.ex: By the time he arrived, the class had already started.
words.ex_cn: 他到的时候，课已经开始了。
words.en: Indicates that something has already happened before a particular time.

words.tr: phrase. 顺便说说；顺便提起
words.ex: By the way, I saw your brother yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 对了，我昨天看到你弟弟了。
words.en: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to the main subject of conversation

words.ex: He passed the test by virtue of his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他凭借努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: Because of or as a result of something.

words.ex: He sent the letter by way of his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他通过朋友寄了这封信。
words.en: If you do something by way of a particular method, you use that method to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；号召；要求；接（人）
words.ex: The situation calls for immediate action.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。
words.en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr: 短语动词. 到此为止，收工，停止工作
words.ex: After working all afternoon, they decided to call it a day.
words.ex_cn: 工作了整个下午后，他们决定收工了。
words.en: If you call it a day, you decide to stop what you are doing because you are tired of it or because it is not successful.

words.tr: phrase. 取消；转移；叫走；依次叫名
words.ex: They decided to call off the meeting because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为风暴决定取消会议。
words.en: To cancel or abandon something that was planned.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call on my grandma this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我将去拜访我的奶奶。
words.en: To visit someone; to formally ask or request someone to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 平静下来；镇定下来
words.ex: Please calm down and talk slowly.
words.ex_cn: 请冷静下来，慢慢说。
words.en: To become or make someone become quiet and relaxed after being angry, excited, or nervous.

words.tr: phrase. 情不自禁做某事；忍不住做某事
words.ex: I can't help laughing when I see that movie.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到那部电影时，我忍不住笑。
words.en: If you say that you can't help doing something, you mean that you can't prevent yourself from doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 照料；关怀；喜欢；想要
words.ex: She cares for her sick mother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她生病的母亲。
words.en: To like or love someone or something; to look after someone or something.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；明白；变得流行
words.ex: He didn't understand the joke at first, but then he caught on.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始没明白这个笑话，但后来明白了。
words.en: To understand or become popular.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；逮捕并处罚；（麻烦事）缠上
words.ex: He needs to catch up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他需要赶上他的同学。
words.en: To reach the same standard or level as someone or something else, especially after a period of lagging behind.

words.ex: She will change into her pajamas after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚饭后会换上睡衣。
words.en: To become something different or to make something become different.

words.tr: phrase. 办理入住手续；调查，查证
words.ex: He will check into the hotel in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 他将在晚上办理酒店入住。
words.en: To register one's arrival at a hotel, airport, etc., or to investigate something.

words.ex: The cat is close to the box.
words.ex_cn: 猫在盒子旁边。
words.en: Near to someone or something in distance or time.

words.ex: How did this mistake come about?
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是怎么发生的？
words.en: If you ask how something came about, you want to know how it happened or started.

words.tr: phrase. 偶遇；偶然发现；使产生…印象
words.ex: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 我在打扫房间时发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: If you come across something or someone, you find them or meet them by chance.

words.ex: The company came into being in 2010.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司成立于2010年。
words.en: To begin to exist or develop.

words.tr: 短语动词. 开始生效；实施；起作用
words.ex: The new law will come into effect next month.
words.ex_cn: 新法律将在下个月生效。
words.en: If a law or agreement comes into effect, it starts to be used or to have an effect.

words.ex: The universe came into existence billions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙在数十亿年前开始存在。
words.en: To begin to exist; to be created or formed.

words.tr: 短语动词. 进入视野；出现
words.ex: The castle came into view as we turned the corner.
words.ex_cn: 当我们转过拐角时，城堡进入了视野。
words.en: to become visible; to appear in sight

words.ex: The movie comes to an end at nine o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 电影在九点结束。
words.en: To reach a point where something stops or finishes.

words.tr: phrase. 真相大白；为人所知
words.ex: The truth came to light after the investigation.
words.ex_cn: 调查之后，真相大白了。
words.en: If something comes to light, it becomes known or is discovered, often after being hidden or secret.

words.tr: phrase. 得出……的结论；最终认为
words.ex: He came to the conclusion that the plan would not work.
words.ex_cn: 他得出结论认为这个计划不会成功。
words.en: To reach a decision or opinion after considering the facts.

words.ex: Her dream will come true next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将会实现。
words.en: If a dream, hope, or prediction comes true, it actually happens.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.ex: Contrary to his words, he did not help.
words.ex_cn: 与他的话相反，他并没有帮忙。
words.en: In opposition to what is expected or believed.

words.tr: 短语动词. 说服某人做某事
words.ex: He convinced his brother to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 他说服他哥哥更努力学习。
words.en: To persuade someone to do something by giving them good reasons.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 对…进行严厉打击；采取严厉措施制止
words.ex: The government will crack down on people who break the rules.
words.ex_cn: 政府将严厉打击违反规则的人。
words.en: To take severe measures against someone or something, especially in order to stop them from doing something illegal or harmful.

words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.tr: phrase. 插嘴；打断；超车抢档
words.ex: He cut in while I was talking.
words.ex_cn: 我正在说话时，他插嘴了。
words.en: To interrupt someone who is speaking, or to move into a line of traffic by driving in front of someone else.

words.ex: He works hard day after day.
words.ex_cn: 他日复一日地努力工作。
words.en: If something happens day after day, it happens every day without changing.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 致力于；献身于；全心全意投入于
words.ex: He dedicates himself to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: To commit oneself to a particular task or purpose with enthusiasm and determination.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.ex: The storm deprived him of his power.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴使他失去了电力。
words.en: To take something away from someone or something; to prevent someone from having something.

words.tr: phrase. 致力于；献身于；全身心投入于
words.ex: He devotes himself to helping poor people.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于帮助贫困人群。
words.en: To give all or a large part of one's time or resources to (a person, activity, or cause).

words.ex: Many people die of cold in winter.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在冬天死于寒冷。
words.en: To die of something means to die because of a particular cause, such as an illness or an accident.

words.ex: Many old traditions die out over time.
words.ex_cn: 许多古老的传统随着时间推移而消失。
words.en: If something dies out, it becomes less and less common and eventually disappears completely.

words.ex: This apple differs from that one in color.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个苹果在颜色上不同。
words.en: to be not the same as something else

words.ex: This color differs from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色和那个不同。
words.en: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 歧视；不公平地对待
words.ex: They should not discriminate against people because of their skin color.
words.ex_cn: 他们不应该因为肤色而歧视他人。
words.en: If someone discriminates against a person or group, they treat them unfairly because of their race, sex, or some other characteristic.

words.tr: phrase. 处理好；处置掉；除掉
words.ex: Please dispose of the trash before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前处理好垃圾。
words.en: To get rid of something that you no longer want or need.

words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.tr: phrase. 转移对……的注意力；使分心，使偏离
words.ex: Don't let noise distract from your homework.
words.ex_cn: 不要让噪音分散你做作业的注意力。
words.en: To distract someone from something means to take their attention away from it.

words.tr: phrase. 消除；终止；废除；杀死；干掉
words.ex: They want to do away with the old rules.
words.ex_cn: 他们想废除旧规则。
words.en: To do away with something means to get rid of it or to stop using it.

words.ex: Exercise can do good to your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼对你的健康有益。
words.en: To be beneficial or advantageous to someone or something.

words.ex: Smoking can do harm to your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会对你的肺造成伤害。
words.en: To cause damage or injury to someone or something.

words.ex: Can you do me a favour and close the window?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我个忙关一下窗户吗？
words.en: to help someone by doing something for them

words.tr: phrase. 与...相处；忍受；处理；与…有关；需要；想做
words.ex: I don't know how to do with him; he is always quiet.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道怎么和他相处；他总是很安静。
words.en: To have a connection or relevance to a particular subject or situation.

words.ex: There are dozens of apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有很多苹果。
words.en: If you refer to dozens of things or people, you are emphasizing that there are very many of them.

words.tr: phrase. 引起对……的注意；使关注
words.ex: He raises his hand to draw attention to his question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手来引起对他的问题的注意。
words.en: To make someone notice or be aware of something.

words.tr: phrase. 抽出；（昼夜）变长；使畅所欲言
words.ex: He drew out a key from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里抽出一把钥匙。
words.en: To make something last longer than usual or to encourage someone to talk or express their feelings.

words.ex: He dreamt of flying like a bird.
words.ex_cn: 他梦见自己像鸟一样飞翔。
words.en: To think about something that you would like to happen or achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 给自己穿衣服；自行穿衣
words.ex: The child can dress himself now.
words.ex_cn: 这孩子现在能自己穿衣服了。
words.en: To put clothes on oneself.

words.ex: I might drop in at your house this evening.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚可能会顺便去你家。
words.en: To visit someone informally and often without notice.

words.ex: He decided to drop out of the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不参加比赛。
words.en: If someone drops out of a school or a course, they leave it before they have finished it.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.ex: They help each other with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们互相帮助做作业。
words.en: You use each other when you are saying that each member of a group does something to or for the other members.

words.ex: He earns his living by fixing cars.
words.ex_cn: 他靠修车谋生。
words.en: To earn one's living means to make enough money to support oneself and one's family, typically through work.

words.ex: The dog ate up all the food.
words.ex_cn: 狗把所有的食物都吃光了。
words.en: To consume all of something, especially food.

words.ex: The story ends in a happy surprise.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事结果是一个快乐的惊喜。
words.en: To have a particular result or conclusion.

words.ex: He forgot his money, so he ended up with nothing.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了带钱，结果什么也没有。
words.en: To eventually be in a particular situation or place, often without intending to.

words.ex: They enjoy themselves at the park every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每个星期天在公园里玩得很开心。
words.en: To have a good time; to experience pleasure or satisfaction in what one is doing.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；包括；参与；成为...一部分
words.ex: He will enter into the room after knocking.
words.ex_cn: 他敲门后会进入房间。
words.en: To begin or become involved in an activity, agreement, or condition.

words.ex: The soldiers were equipped with new rifles.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们配备了新步枪。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: Everyone came to the party except for Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加派对了。
words.en: You use except for to introduce the only thing or person that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.ex: They talked face to face instead of on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他们面对面交谈，而不是打电话。
words.en: If you meet or talk to someone face to face, you meet or talk to them directly, rather than by telephone, email, or online.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐消失；慢慢减弱
words.ex: The music fades away slowly.
words.ex_cn: 音乐慢慢消失了。
words.en: To gradually disappear or become less noticeable.

words.ex: He falls in love with her when he sees her smile.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到她的微笑时，他就爱上了她。
words.en: To begin to feel romantic love for someone.

words.ex: He fell into the river by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心掉进了河里。
words.en: To fall into something means to be classified or divided into it, or to start to be in a particular state or condition.

words.ex: The book fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 书从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: If something falls off, it becomes detached from something to which it was attached.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 未能达到；不足；不够
words.ex: He fell short of the target score.
words.ex_cn: 他没能达到目标分数。
words.en: To not reach the standard or level that is expected or required.

words.ex: The village is far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄远离城市。
words.en: If you say that something is far from a particular thing or far from being the case, you are emphasizing that it is not that particular thing or not at all the case, especially when people expect or assume that it is.

words.ex: He has a fear of heights.
words.ex_cn: 他害怕高处。
words.en: An anxious feeling about a potential danger or threat.

words.tr: 短语动词. 感到自在；感到轻松；无拘无束
words.ex: She feels at ease when she is with her friends.
words.ex_cn: 当她和朋友在一起时，她感到轻松。
words.en: If you feel at ease, you feel relaxed and comfortable, especially because you are in familiar surroundings or with people you know.

words.tr: phrase. 感到不安；觉得不自在
words.ex: He feels ill at ease in big crowds.
words.ex_cn: 他在人多的地方感到不自在。
words.en: To feel uncomfortable or anxious in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；弄明白；解决；想出
words.ex: I can't figure out the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我算不出答案。
words.en: To understand or solve something by thinking about it.

words.tr: phrase. 填（写）； 填满；替代
words.ex: Please fill in the blanks with the correct words.
words.ex_cn: 请用正确的单词填空。
words.en: If you fill in a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

words.ex: Please fill out this form before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前填写这张表格。
words.en: To complete a form or document by providing the required information.

words.ex: He tried to fill up the hole with sand.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用沙子填补那个洞。
words.en: To make something full, or to become full.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.ex: First of all, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: Before anything else; initially.

words.tr: 短语. 换换口味；改变一下；为了有所不同
words.ex: He ate pasta for a change.
words.ex_cn: 他换换口味，吃了意大利面。
words.en: If you do something for a change, you do something different from your usual routine or habits.

words.tr: 短语. 为不时之需；以备将来困难时使用
words.ex: He saved some money for a rainy day.
words.ex_cn: 他存了一些钱以备不时之需。
words.en: If you save something, especially money, for a rainy day, you save it for a time in the future when you might need it.

words.ex: He slept for a while.
words.ex_cn: 他睡了一会儿。
words.en: For a period of time; not permanently.

words.ex: I know for certain that he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我确信他会来。
words.en: If you know something for certain, you have no doubt about it.

words.ex: I will love you forever.
words.ex_cn: 我会永远爱你。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or continue forever, you mean that it will always happen or continue.

words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.tr: phrase. 肯定地；毫无疑问地
words.ex: He will come for sure.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会来。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.ex: He smiled for the first time today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天第一次笑了。
words.en: If something happens for the first time, it has never happened before.

words.ex: He woke up early for the purpose of catching the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶公交车。
words.en: If you do something for the purpose of achieving a particular result, you do it in order to achieve that result.

words.ex: He studied hard for the sake of his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习是为了家人。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result.

words.tr: phrase. v. 忘记做过某事（指忘记已经做过的事情）
words.ex: I forget doing my homework last night.
words.ex_cn: 我忘了昨晚做过作业了。
words.en: To fail to remember having done something.

words.tr: phrase. 忘记去做某事（指未做应做的事）
words.ex: I forget to do my homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天都忘记做作业。
words.en: If you forget to do something, you do not remember to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 从……的角度来看；从……的观点出发
words.ex: From my point of view, the movie is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，这部电影非常有趣。
words.en: Considering the perspective or opinion of someone or something.

words.ex: From now on, I will study every day.
words.ex_cn: 从现在开始，我会每天学习。
words.en: Starting from this moment and continuing into the future.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents from time to time.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If you do something from time to time, you do it occasionally but not regularly.

words.tr: phrase. v. 开始了解；熟悉；与……相识
words.ex: He got acquainted with his new classmates on the first day.
words.ex_cn: 他在第一天认识了新同学。
words.en: To become familiar with someone or something.

words.ex: I get along with my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的邻居相处得很好。
words.en: If you get along with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them.

words.tr: phrase. 着手做；开始认真做
words.ex: He got down to work after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后开始认真工作。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something seriously or with determination.

words.tr: 短语动词. 与……取得联系
words.ex: I will get in contact with my teacher tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会联系我的老师。
words.en: To initiate communication with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；陷入；染上（坏习惯）
words.ex: He wants to get into a good university.
words.ex_cn: 他想进入一所好大学。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a particular activity, situation, or state.

words.tr: phrase. v. 走开，消失；迷路
words.ex: He told the noisy boy to get lost.
words.ex_cn: 他让那个吵闹的男孩走开。
words.en: If you tell someone to get lost, you are telling them in a rude way to go away.

words.ex: They got married last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年夏天结婚了。
words.en: To enter into the state of matrimony; to become husband and wife.

words.ex: He wants to get rid of the old chair.
words.ex_cn: 他想扔掉那把旧椅子。
words.en: To dispose of or remove something unwanted or undesirable.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 完成；结束（某事）；应付过去
words.ex: I finally get through with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我终于完成了我的家庭作业。
words.en: To finish or complete something, especially something that is difficult or unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 赠送；分发；背叛；泄露
words.ex: He will give away his old books to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他将把他的旧书捐给图书馆。
words.en: To give something to someone without asking for payment, or to reveal something secret or private.

words.ex: She will give birth to a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她下个月要生孩子。
words.en: To bring a baby or young animal into the world by birth.

words.tr: phrase. 屈服于；向…让步；投降
words.ex: Don't give in to fear when you face a challenge.
words.ex_cn: 当你面对挑战时，不要向恐惧屈服。
words.en: To yield to someone or something, especially after resisting for a period of time.

words.ex: Poor hygiene can give rise to infections.
words.ex_cn: 不良的卫生习惯可能导致感染。
words.en: To cause something to happen or exist.

words.ex: Can you give me a hand with this box?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？
words.en: To help someone with something.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.ex: The old rules give way to new ones.
words.ex_cn: 旧规则让位于新规则。
words.en: If something gives way to something else, it is replaced by it.

words.ex: The milk will go bad if you leave it out of the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 如果你把牛奶放在冰箱外面，它会变质的。
words.en: If food goes bad, it is no longer fresh or good to eat.

words.tr: 短语动词. 破产；倒闭
words.ex: He went bankrupt after the business failed.
words.ex_cn: 他的生意失败后破产了。
words.en: To go bankrupt means to become unable to pay one's debts and thus to have one's financial affairs administered under the bankruptcy laws.

words.ex: Time goes by quickly when you are happy.
words.ex_cn: 当你开心时，时间过得很快。
words.en: If you say that time goes by, you mean that it passes.

words.tr: 短语动词. 各自付账；各付各的（尤指用餐时）
words.ex: We decided to go dutch for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们决定吃饭时AA制。
words.en: If two or more people go dutch, each person pays for their own meal, drink, or entertainment instead of one person paying for everything.

words.ex: He goes on talking even when no one listens.
words.ex_cn: 即使没人听，他还是继续说。
words.en: To continue an activity or process, especially after a pause or interruption.

words.ex: They go out to watch a movie on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末外出看电影。
words.en: To leave a place, especially one's home, for a short time, usually for a specific purpose such as entertainment or socializing.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查；复习；重做；转向；受欢迎
words.ex: I will go over my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会复习我的家庭作业。
words.en: To examine or review something carefully; to cross over something.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 出错； 发生故障；误入歧途
words.ex: Things can go wrong if you don't follow the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不按照说明做，事情可能会出错。
words.en: If a situation or event goes wrong, it does not happen in the way you intended or expected, and often has a bad result.

words.ex: He will graduate from high school next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将从高中毕业。
words.en: To successfully complete a course of study at a school, college, or university and receive a degree or diploma.

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.tr: phrase. 手拉手地；紧密地；同时发生地
words.ex: They walk hand in hand in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们手拉手在公园里散步。
words.en: If two people are hand in hand, they are holding each other's hand. If two things go hand in hand, they are closely connected and one thing causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 挂断；拖延；把...挂起来
words.ex: He hung up the phone after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 争吵后，他挂断了电话。
words.en: To end a telephone conversation by breaking the connection; to suspend something from above so that it is supported only from above.

words.tr: phrase. v. 心里想着……；打算……；考虑……
words.ex: Do you have anyone in mind for the job?
words.ex_cn: 你心里有合适的人选吗？
words.en: If you have something in mind, you are thinking about it as a possibility or as a plan.

words.tr: 短语动词。熟练掌握；对……有很好的掌控能力
words.ex: He has a good command of English.
words.ex_cn: 他精通英语。
words.en: To be proficient in or have a thorough knowledge of something, especially a language or a skill.

words.ex: He has a monopoly on selling ice cream in this town.
words.ex_cn: 他在这座小镇上垄断了冰淇淋的销售。
words.en: If a company, person, or state has a monopoly on something such as an industry, they have complete control over it, so that it is impossible for others to become involved in it.

words.tr: phrase. 对…有偏爱；对…缺乏抵抗力
words.ex: I have a weakness for chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 我对巧克力情有独钟。
words.en: If you have a weakness for something, you like it very much, even though it may not be good for you.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对……有鉴赏力；善于发现……的美或价值
words.ex: She has an eye for beautiful clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她对漂亮的衣服很敏感。
words.en: If you have an eye for something, you are good at noticing it or you have a natural ability to appreciate it.

words.tr: phrase. 对…有影响；对…起作用；产生效果
words.ex: Smoking has an impact on your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有影响。
words.en: To have a significant effect on someone or something.

words.ex: Parents can have an influence on their children's habits.
words.ex_cn: 父母可以影响孩子的习惯。
words.en: To affect or change how someone or something develops, behaves, or thinks.

words.ex: I have confidence in my brother.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我的兄弟。
words.en: To believe in someone's or something's abilities or qualities.

words.tr: 短语动词. 在……方面有困难
words.ex: He has difficulty in understanding math.
words.ex_cn: 他在理解数学方面有困难。
words.en: To experience problems or obstacles in doing something.

words.tr: 有充分的理由去做某事
words.ex: You have every reason to be happy.
words.ex_cn: 你有充分的理由感到快乐。
words.en: To have a strong and justifiable basis or motive for doing something.

words.ex: I have faith in you to do the right thing.
words.ex_cn: 我相信你会做正确的事。
words.en: To believe in the reliability, truth, or ability of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 与……关系不大；与……几乎没有关联
words.ex: The weather has little to do with his decision.
words.ex_cn: 天气和他的决定没什么关系。
words.en: To be not very much connected with or involved in something.

words.ex: He has no choice but to go to school.
words.ex_cn: 他别无选择，只能去上学。
words.en: To be forced to do something because there is no other option.

words.tr: phrase. 不知道；不清楚；不了解
words.ex: I have no idea where the bus stop is.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道公交车站在哪里。
words.en: If you have no idea about something, you do not know anything about it or you have no understanding of it.

words.ex: This problem has nothing to do with math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数学无关。
words.en: If you say that something has nothing to do with a particular subject or situation, you mean that it is not connected with it in any way.

words.tr: phrase. 有权做某事；有权力或权限去做某事
words.ex: The manager has the authority to approve the request.
words.ex_cn: 经理有权批准这个请求。
words.en: To have the power or right to do something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有权做某事；有权利进行某种行为
words.ex: Every child has the right to go to school.
words.ex_cn: 每个孩子都有权利上学。
words.en: to be legally or morally entitled to do something

words.ex: He heads for the station every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上前往车站。
words.en: To move or travel towards a particular place or direction.

words.ex: I haven't heard from my friend for a week.
words.ex_cn: 我一周没有收到我朋友的消息了。
words.en: to receive communication from someone

words.ex: I have never heard of that song before.
words.ex_cn: 我以前从未听说过那首歌。
words.en: To become aware of something through hearing about it from someone else.

words.tr: phrase. v. 自取所需；随便享用（食物或饮料）
words.ex: Please help yourself to some cookies on the table.
words.ex_cn: 请随意吃一些桌上的饼干。
words.en: To take something for oneself without asking for permission, often used when offering something to someone.

words.tr: 短语动词：帮助某人做某事，协助某人处理某事
words.ex: He helps me with my homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天帮我做作业。
words.en: If you help someone with something, you assist them in doing it.

words.ex: I hit on a great cafe while walking in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园散步时偶然发现了一家很棒的咖啡馆。
words.en: To suddenly have a good idea or to flirt with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 抓紧不放；继续；不挂断；坚持
words.ex: Hold on the rope tightly!
words.ex_cn: 紧紧抓住绳子！
words.en: To continue to do something or to wait for a short time.

words.ex: He holds his breath when he waits for the result.
words.ex_cn: 他等待结果时屏住呼吸。
words.en: If you hold your breath, you make yourself stop breathing for a moment, usually because you are waiting for something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. v. 紧紧抓住；坚持不放；保留
words.ex: He holds onto his old bike because it reminds him of his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他保留着那辆旧自行车，因为它让他想起童年。
words.en: To keep something tightly in one's grasp or to not let go of something, either physically or metaphorically.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；支撑；继续下去；推举；阻挡；拦截；持械抢劫
words.ex: He held up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To hold something up means to keep it in a high position so that it does not fall or to support it. It can also mean to delay or stop the progress of something or someone, or to rob someone using violence or the threat of violence.

words.tr: phrase. 把负担强加于；使承担（责任、费用等）
words.ex: High taxes can impose a burden on poor families.
words.ex_cn: 高税收会给贫困家庭带来负担。
words.en: To place a heavy load or responsibility on someone or something.

words.ex: He is in a hurry to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶着去赶公交车。
words.en: If you are in a hurry, you are doing something quickly because you do not have much time.

words.ex: I will do it in a minute.
words.ex_cn: 我马上做。
words.en: Used to indicate that something will happen very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 惊慌地；处于恐慌中；在惊恐状态下
words.ex: He ran out in a panic when he saw the fire.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到火灾时，他惊慌地跑了出去。
words.en: In a state of sudden, overwhelming fear or anxiety.

words.tr: phrase. 马上；立刻；稍等片刻
words.ex: I'll be there in a second.
words.ex_cn: 我马上就到。
words.en: In a second means very soon or immediately.

words.ex: In a sense, he is right.
words.ex_cn: 在某种意义上，他是对的。
words.en: You say in a sense to indicate that a statement is true in one way, but not in others.

words.ex: He is lazy, in a word.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他很懒。
words.en: used to give a summary or to introduce a conclusion

words.ex: He acted in accordance with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他按照规则行事。
words.en: If something is done in accordance with a particular rule or system, it is done in the way that the rule or system says that it should be done.

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: phrase. 简单地说；简而言之；简单扼要地
words.ex: In brief, he likes soccer.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢足球。
words.en: In a few words; concisely.

words.tr: phrase. 假使；如果；万一；以防
words.ex: Keep a flashlight in case of power outage.
words.ex_cn: 以防停电，准备一个手电筒。
words.en: used to describe what should be done if a particular situation, especially a bad one, occurs

words.ex: They have nothing in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们没有什么共同点。
words.en: If two or more people have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences.

words.ex: He runs fast, in comparison with his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，与他哥哥相比。
words.en: Used to say that something is being considered in relation to something else, especially to show how they are different or similar.

words.ex: He forgot his homework, in consequence, he got a bad grade.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了做作业，结果得了低分。
words.en: As a result; therefore.

words.ex: He likes cats. In contrast, she prefers dogs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢猫。相比之下，她更喜欢狗。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.ex: He explained the plan in detail.
words.ex_cn: 他详细地解释了这个计划。
words.en: Including all the facts or aspects of a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 认真地；诚挚地；正正经经
words.ex: He started working in earnest after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后认真开始工作。
words.en: If you do something in earnest, you do it with serious and sincere intentions.

words.ex: The new rule is in effect from Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规定从周一开始生效。
words.en: If a law or rule is in effect, it is operating or being applied.

words.ex: He gave me a book in exchange for a pen.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本书换了我的钢笔。
words.en: If you give or do something in exchange for something else, you give or do it in order to get that thing.

words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.ex: Wearing blue jeans is in fashion now.
words.ex_cn: 现在穿牛仔裤很流行。
words.en: If something is in fashion, it is popular or considered to be attractive at a particular time.

words.ex: He is in favour of eating more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favour of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.tr: phrase. 充足；以全文；全部地
words.ex: He paid the bill in full.
words.ex_cn: 他全额支付了账单。
words.en: If something is done or happens in full, it is done or happens completely.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；大体上；一般而言
words.ex: In general, he likes to eat fruit.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢吃水果。
words.en: Usually; in most cases.

words.tr: 状态良好：指物品或人的状态良好，没有损坏或疾病。
words.ex: The car is in good condition.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车状况良好。
words.en: If something is in good condition, it is in a good state or quality, especially because it has been well looked after.

words.tr: phrase. 与...协调一致；与...和谐
words.ex: The painting is in harmony with the room's colors.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画与房间的颜色相协调。
words.en: If one thing is in harmony with another, the first thing suits the second or they seem right together.

words.tr: phrase. 匆忙地；急忙地；草率地
words.ex: He wrote the letter in haste.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙写了这封信。
words.en: Done quickly, often without careful thought.

words.tr: phrase. 向...表示敬意；为祝贺...
words.ex: They planted a tree in honor of her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他们种了一棵树以纪念她的生日。
words.en: If something is arranged or happens in honor of a particular event or person, it is done to celebrate that event or to show respect and admiration for that person.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；一致；与…成一直线
words.ex: His decision is in line with the company's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定符合公司的规定。
words.en: In agreement or conformity with something.

words.tr: phrase. 处于困境中；需要帮助（或救济）的
words.ex: He is in need of help.
words.ex_cn: 他需要帮助。
words.en: If someone is in need, they are very poor and require help.

words.ex: He finished his homework in no time.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就完成了作业。
words.en: Very quickly or soon.

words.ex: He left the room in obedience to his teacher's order.
words.ex_cn: 他遵照老师的命令离开了房间。
words.en: In compliance with or submission to the authority, guidance, or instruction of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 按次序的；合乎程序的；井然有序
words.ex: Please line up in order.
words.ex_cn: 请按次序排队。
words.en: In the correct sequence or arrangement; appropriate or required by the circumstances.

words.ex: I'm tired; in other words, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我累了；换句话说，我需要休息。
words.en: Used to introduce a different way of saying the same thing, often to make it clearer or more understandable.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: He succeeded in part because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他部分成功是因为他努力工作。
words.en: To some extent; not completely.

words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.ex: I will see you in person tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天亲自见你。
words.en: If you do something in person, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it for you.

words.ex: He knows the rules, but in practice, he forgets them.
words.ex_cn: 他知道这些规则，但在实践中却忘了。
words.en: Used to say what actually happens or is done, especially when this is different from what is expected or supposed to happen.

words.ex: The project is in progress.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: If something is in progress, it has started and is still continuing.

words.ex: The cost is in proportion to the size of the room.
words.ex_cn: 费用与房间的大小成正比。
words.en: If one thing changes or is done in proportion to another, it changes or is done according to how much the other thing changes or is done.

words.tr: phrase. 在期望中；可预期；即将出现
words.ex: A new job is in prospect for him.
words.ex_cn: 他有望得到一份新工作。
words.en: If something is in prospect, it is likely to happen in the future.

words.ex: He sings in public every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都在公共场合唱歌。
words.en: In a way that can be seen or heard by other people; openly.

words.ex: He spoke in regard to the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他谈到了新的校规。
words.en: Concerning or about something.

words.ex: He helped me, and I gave him a gift in return for it.
words.ex_cn: 他帮了我，我送他一份礼物作为回报。
words.en: If you do something in return for something that someone has done for you, you do it because they did that thing for you.

words.ex: He is in search of a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在寻找一份新工作。
words.en: If you are in search of something, you are looking for it.

words.tr: phrase. 当季；正当时；处于旺季
words.ex: Apples are in season in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 苹果在秋天是当季的。
words.en: If a fruit or vegetable is in season, it is the time of year when it is ready for eating and is widely available.

words.ex: In short, he likes pizza.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢披萨。
words.en: used to introduce a summary of something that has just been said or to give a brief statement of the main points.

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.tr: phrase. 连续地；接连地；一个接一个地
words.ex: He won three games in succession.
words.ex_cn: 他连续赢了三场比赛。
words.en: Following one after another without interruption.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.tr: phrase. 在黑暗中；秘密地；不知道地
words.ex: The children played in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在黑暗中玩耍。
words.en: If you are in the dark about something, you do not know anything about it.

words.ex: In the end, he chose to go home.
words.ex_cn: 最后，他选择回家。
words.en: finally, after everything has been considered or done

words.ex: He stayed calm in the face of danger.
words.ex_cn: 他在危险面前保持冷静。
words.en: If you do something in the face of a particular situation, you do it despite the difficulties or problems that the situation causes.

words.tr: phrase. 首先；从一开始；压根
words.ex: I didn't go out in the first place.
words.ex_cn: 我根本就没出去。
words.en: used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce the first of several reasons, facts, or points that you want to make

words.ex: I will go to college in the future.
words.ex_cn: 我将来会去上大学。
words.en: at a time after the present

words.ex: He changed his mind in the light of new facts.
words.ex_cn: 根据新事实，他改变了主意。
words.en: If you do or decide something in the light of something else, you do it or decide it after considering that thing.

words.ex: In the long run, eating healthy saves money on doctor visits.
words.ex_cn: 从长远来看，健康饮食可以节省看医生的费用。
words.en: Over an extended period of time; in the future, especially in the distant future.

words.ex: He cooked dinner; meantime, the kids did their homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做晚饭；与此同时，孩子们在做作业。
words.en: The time between one event and another; meanwhile.

words.ex: He acted in the name of justice.
words.ex_cn: 他以正义的名义行动。
words.en: If you do something in the name of a particular cause or principle, you do it in order to support that cause or principle.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: The box is in the way.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子挡路了。
words.en: If something or someone is in the way, they prevent you from moving or from doing something.

words.ex: He is the best player in the world.
words.ex_cn: 他是世界上最好的球员。
words.en: Used to emphasize the question of what exists or happens in the world, or to emphasize a superlative.

words.tr: phrase. 依次；轮流；结果；反过来
words.ex: The students spoke in turn to answer the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 学生们依次回答老师的问题。
words.en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, especially because one causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 白费地； 徒劳地
words.ex: He cried in vain for help.
words.ex_cn: 他呼救却无济于事。
words.en: If you do something in vain, you do not succeed in achieving what you intend.

words.ex: He stayed home in view of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雨，他待在家里。
words.en: You use 'in view of' when you are taking into consideration a particular fact or situation that is important in relation to what you are saying or doing.

words.ex: He likes to indulge in chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后吃巧克力。
words.en: To allow oneself to enjoy the pleasure of something, often something that is considered bad for you.

words.tr: phrase. 告知；通知；向…报告（某事）
words.ex: Please inform about the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 请告知会议时间。
words.en: To tell someone about something, especially facts or news.

words.ex: Please inform me of any changes.
words.ex_cn: 请告知我任何变化。
words.en: To give someone facts or information about something.

words.ex: He insists on walking to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持每天步行上学。
words.en: If you insist on something, you demand it and refuse to accept any alternative.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 打算做某事；有意做某事；计划做某事
words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 就在附近；即将来临；近在咫尺
words.ex: The grocery store is just around the corner.
words.ex_cn: 杂货店就在拐角处。
words.en: If you say that something is just around the corner, you mean that it will happen very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 以防万一；以备不时之需
words.ex: I brought an umbrella just in case it rains.
words.ex_cn: 我带了伞，以防下雨。
words.en: As a precaution; in the event that something happens.

words.tr: phrase. 将…秘而不宣；对…守口如瓶；不与他人分享…
words.ex: He decided to keep his feelings to himself.
words.ex_cn: 他决定把自己的感受藏在心里。
words.en: If you keep something to yourself, you do not tell anyone else about it.

words.ex: Please keep an eye on the baby while I cook.
words.ex_cn: 我做饭时，请照看一下宝宝。
words.en: To watch or look after someone or something carefully.

words.ex: Keep away from the sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 远离那把锋利的刀。
words.en: To avoid someone or something; to stay at a distance from someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 与…交往；陪伴；与…为伍
words.ex: He keeps company with his best friend every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都和最好的朋友在一起。
words.en: To associate or spend time with someone, often implying a social or friendly relationship.

words.tr: phrase. 早睡早起；保持早起的作息
words.ex: My grandfather keeps early hours; he goes to bed at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父早睡早起，晚上8点就上床睡觉了。
words.en: To go to bed and get up early as a regular habit.

words.ex: Keep in mind that the bus leaves at 6 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 记住，公交车六点发车。
words.en: To remember or not forget something.

words.ex: I keep in touch with my friend by texting.
words.ex_cn: 我通过发短信和朋友保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone.

words.ex: He keeps on walking even when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 即使累了，他还是继续走。
words.en: If you keep on doing something, you continue to do it and do not stop.

words.ex: He keeps his word and always does what he promises.
words.ex_cn: 他信守诺言，总是做他承诺过的事情。
words.en: To do what one has promised to do.

words.ex: He keeps to his schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都遵守自己的日程。
words.en: To continue to do something or to stay in a particular state or condition.

words.ex: I keep track of my expenses every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天记录我的开支。
words.en: To keep track of something means to stay informed about it or to record it, especially in order to notice any changes or developments.

words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 消磨时间；打发时间
words.ex: He reads comics to kill time.
words.ex_cn: 他看漫画来打发时间。
words.en: To spend time doing something that is not particularly useful or interesting, especially while waiting for something else to happen.

words.ex: He failed the test because of lack of sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺乏睡眠而考试不及格。
words.en: The state of being without or not having enough of something.

words.tr: phrase. 把……放在一边；搁置；储蓄；抛弃
words.ex: He lay aside his book and stood up.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在一边，站了起来。
words.en: To put something to one side, especially for a short time, in order to do something else.

words.ex: The company will lay off 50 workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将裁员50人。
words.en: To terminate the employment of a worker or workers, especially temporarily, because there is not enough work for them to do.

words.ex: The students learn the poem by heart.
words.ex_cn: 学生们把这首诗背熟了。
words.en: To memorize something thoroughly so that it can be recited or written without hesitation.

words.ex: He left behind his book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书留在了桌子上。
words.en: To go away from a place without taking someone or something with you.

words.ex: He can't even walk, let alone run.
words.ex_cn: 他连走都走不了，更别说跑了。
words.en: Used to emphasize the improbability of a contrasting example.

words.tr: phrase. 使失望；辜负；放下；降低
words.ex: He let down his team by missing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他因为没参加比赛而让队友失望了。
words.en: To fail to support or help someone as they had hoped or expected.

words.ex: He lies in bed on Sunday mornings.
words.ex_cn: 他在周日早上睡懒觉。
words.en: To be the main or most important part of something; to stay in bed longer than usual in the morning.

words.tr: phrase. 继续生存； 以...为主食, 靠...生活
words.ex: The old man lives on small donations from neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人靠邻居们的小额捐款继续生存。
words.en: To continue to exist or be remembered; to have a particular type of food or income as one's main source of sustenance.

words.ex: He longs for his hometown.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望他的家乡。
words.en: To have a strong wish or desire for something.

words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.tr: phrase. 调查；研究；观察；检查
words.ex: The police will look into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查这起事故。
words.en: If you look into a problem or matter, you investigate it or examine it.

words.tr: phrase. 察看；检查；翻阅；原谅；从...上面看
words.ex: He will look over his homework before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉前会检查一下作业。
words.en: To examine or inspect something quickly or casually.

words.ex: I look up the word in the dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在字典里查这个词。
words.en: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

words.ex: He didn't apologize because he didn't want to lose face.
words.ex_cn: 他没有道歉，因为他不想丢脸。
words.en: To lose face means to be humiliated or to lose the respect of others, often in a social context.

words.ex: He lost his way in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里迷路了。
words.en: to become unable to find one's way

words.ex: He drove so fast that he lost sight of the road.
words.ex_cn: 他开得太快，看不见路了。
words.en: If you lose sight of something, you forget about it or stop thinking about it because you are focusing on other things.

words.ex: He wants to major in biology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学主修生物学。
words.en: To specialize in a particular subject or field of study at a college or university.

words.tr: phrase. 做出选择；作出抉择
words.ex: He must make a choice today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天必须做出选择。
words.en: To decide between two or more possibilities.

words.tr: phrase. 为…做出贡献；对…有所贡献；向…捐款
words.ex: He wants to make a contribution to the school library.
words.ex_cn: 他想为学校图书馆做点贡献。
words.en: To give or provide something that helps to improve a situation or to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 要紧；区别对待；有影响；起（重要）作用
words.ex: Volunteering can make a difference in your community.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务能为你的社区带来改变。
words.en: If something makes a difference, it affects someone or something positively, especially in a noticeable or important way.

words.ex: He made a face when he tasted the sour lemon.
words.ex_cn: 他尝到酸柠檬时皱起了脸。
words.en: To make a facial expression, often to show emotion or amusement.

words.tr: phrase. 出丑；闹笑话；让自己出洋相
words.ex: He made a fool of himself at the party by singing loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上大声唱歌，出丑了。
words.en: To behave in a way that makes other people think you are silly or not to be respected.

words.tr: phrase. 发出令人不愉快的声音
words.ex: The baby made a noise while eating.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝吃饭时发出了令人不愉快的声音。
words.en: To create a sound, especially an unwanted or disruptive one.

words.tr: phrase. 特意做；认为…很重要；总是要做（某事）；坚持要
words.ex: He makes a point of exercising every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持每天早上锻炼。
words.en: If you make a point of doing something, you do it in a very deliberate way, often to show that you think it is important.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；体谅；为…留有余地
words.ex: The teacher makes allowance for students who are late because of traffic.
words.ex_cn: 老师会考虑到因交通堵塞而迟到的学生。
words.en: To take into consideration when making a judgment or decision.

words.ex: I will make an appointment with the doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要预约医生。
words.en: To arrange a meeting or consultation at a specific time.

words.tr: phrase. 努力；尽力；作出努力
words.ex: He makes an effort to wake up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力早起。
words.en: To attempt to do something, especially when it requires a significant amount of work or determination.

words.tr: phrase. 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计；量入为出
words.ex: He works two jobs to make both ends meet.
words.ex_cn: 他做两份工作来维持收支平衡。
words.en: To have enough money to pay for the things that you need.

words.ex: He wants to make friends with the new student.
words.ex_cn: 他想和新同学交朋友。
words.en: To become friendly with someone, or to start a friendship with them.

words.ex: They make fun of him for wearing old shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他穿旧鞋子而取笑他。
words.en: To tease, laugh at, or joke about someone in a way that is either playful or mocking.

words.ex: He makes money by selling cakes.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卖蛋糕赚钱。
words.en: To earn or obtain money through work, investment, or other means.

words.ex: It makes no difference to me whether we eat now or later.
words.ex_cn: 我们是现在吃还是待会儿吃，对我来说都一样。
words.en: If something makes no difference, it does not change the situation or the outcome in any way.

words.ex: He makes his living by selling vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他靠在市场卖蔬菜谋生。
words.en: To earn the money one needs to live.

words.tr: phrase. 请随意；别拘束；像在自己家一样
words.ex: Please make yourself at home and sit on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 请随便一点，坐在沙发上。
words.en: To behave as if you are in your own home, especially by relaxing and being comfortable.

words.tr: phrase. 使别人听见自己的声音；让自己的意见被听到
words.ex: He raised his voice to make himself heard.
words.ex_cn: 他提高声音以便让人听到。
words.en: To ensure that one's voice or message is clearly understood by others, especially in a situation where it is difficult to be heard.

words.tr: phrase. 讲得通； 有意义； 言之有理
words.ex: This plan makes sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划有道理。
words.en: To be reasonable or understandable.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.ex: He makes the most of his time to study.
words.ex_cn: 他充分利用时间学习。
words.en: To use something to its fullest potential or to take full advantage of an opportunity.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.ex: He worked extra hours to make up for the lost time.
words.ex_cn: 他加班工作来弥补失去的时间。
words.en: To compensate for something that is lacking or has been lost.

words.ex: He made up his mind to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他下定决心戒烟。
words.en: To decide something after considering it carefully.

words.ex: He makes use of old books to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他利用旧书来省钱。
words.en: To use something or someone in order to achieve a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 让路给；为…腾出空间；给…让位
words.ex: The old building was torn down to make way for a new park.
words.ex_cn: 旧建筑被拆除了，为新公园让路。
words.en: If you make way for someone or something, you move aside so that they can pass or so that there is space for them.

words.tr: phrase. 满足需求；符合要求
words.ex: The new factory must meet the demands of customers.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂必须满足客户的需求。
words.en: To satisfy the needs or requirements of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 把…看错成；把…误解成
words.ex: He often mistakes the cat for the dog.
words.ex_cn: 他经常把猫错认成狗。
words.en: To confuse someone or something with another person or thing.

words.ex: He is more or less ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他差不多准备好考试了。
words.en: To a certain extent; approximately.

words.tr: phrase. 搬到；迁移到；移动到；转移到
words.ex: They want to move to a new house next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们想下个月搬到一个新房子。
words.en: To relocate to a different place or position.

words.tr: phrase. 不少于；多达；竟然；正是
words.ex: He has no less than five brothers and sisters.
words.ex_cn: 他有整整五个兄弟姐妹。
words.en: used to emphasize that a particular number, amount, etc., is surprisingly large

words.ex: He no longer plays soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他不再踢足球了。
words.en: If something is no longer the case, it is not the case now, although it was the case in the past.

words.ex: You can eat no more than three cookies.
words.ex_cn: 你最多只能吃三块饼干。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is not more than a particular amount, number, or level

words.tr: phrase. 与某人无关；不关某人的事
words.ex: What I do is none of your business.
words.ex_cn: 我做什么不关你的事。
words.en: If you say that something is none of someone's business, you mean that it is not their concern or responsibility.

words.ex: He has nothing but praise for his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师只有赞美。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is only what you say it is and nothing more

words.ex: He visits his grandparents now and then.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.tr: phrase. 非常有趣的；引起极大兴趣的；备受关注的
words.ex: The movie is of great interest to children.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影对孩子们非常有趣。
words.en: Something that is of great interest is very interesting or important to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 非常有用的；极有帮助的；具有很大用途的
words.ex: This book is of great use for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语非常有用。
words.en: Being of great use means being very helpful or beneficial in a particular situation or for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 属于自己的；自己专有的
words.ex: Every child should have a room of his own.
words.ex_cn: 每个孩子都应该有自己的房间。
words.en: belonging to oneself and no one else

words.tr: phrase. 大规模地；大范围地
words.ex: They built houses on a large scale after the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 地震后，他们大规模地建造房屋。
words.en: Involving a large number of people or things, or covering a large area.

words.ex: He was late on account of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车。
words.en: Because of something; due to something.

words.ex: On average, children sleep 10 hours a night.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，儿童每天睡10个小时。
words.en: If you say that something is true on average, you mean that it is generally the case.

words.tr: phrase. 断断续续地；间歇地；时有时无地
words.ex: He visits his grandma on and off.
words.ex_cn: 他断断续续地去看望奶奶。
words.en: If something happens on and off, or off and on, it happens occasionally, or only for part of a period of time, not in a regular or continuous way.

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的妹妹发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.ex: The captain asked the crew to get on board.
words.ex_cn: 船长让船员们上船。
words.en: On board means to be on a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.

words.ex: He is traveling on business.
words.ex_cn: 他出差。
words.en: If someone is on business, they are away from their usual place of work because they are doing something connected with their job.

words.ex: You can go out on condition that you come home before 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 你可以出去，条件是你必须在晚上10点前回家。
words.en: used to say that one thing will happen only if another thing happens

words.tr: phrase. 值班的；当值的；值勤的；在上班
words.ex: The nurse is on duty tonight.
words.ex_cn: 护士今晚在值班。
words.en: If someone is on duty, they are working at a particular time.

words.ex: He goes to school on foot.
words.ex_cn: 他步行去学校。
words.en: By walking.

words.tr: phrase. 绝不；无论如何都不；在任何情况下都不
words.ex: On no account should you leave the house without your keys.
words.ex_cn: 绝对不可以不带钥匙就离开家。
words.en: Under no circumstances; never.

words.ex: On occasions, I walk to work instead of driving.
words.ex_cn: 偶尔，我会走路去上班而不是开车。
words.en: At times; now and then.

words.ex: He solved the problem on his own.
words.ex_cn: 他自己解决了这个问题。
words.en: If you do something on your own, you do it without any help from other people.

words.ex: He is on his way to school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在去学校的路上。
words.en: If you are on your way to a place, you are traveling towards it and have not yet arrived.

words.ex: He broke the vase on purpose.
words.ex_cn: 他故意打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If you do something on purpose, you do it intentionally, not by accident.

words.tr: phrase. 转念一想；经过重新考虑后
words.ex: I will go to the party. On second thought, I will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 我打算去派对。再想想，我还是待在家里吧。
words.en: After reconsidering; used to indicate a change of mind or opinion.

words.ex: He says he likes quiet, on the contrary, he always listens to loud music.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢安静，相反，他总是听大声的音乐。
words.en: You use 'on the contrary' when you are contradicting what has just been said or implied, or making a contrast between two things.

words.ex: I like coffee, on the other hand, my brother prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，另一方面，我弟弟更喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously

words.ex: He answered the question on the spot.
words.ex_cn: 他当场回答了问题。
words.en: If you do something on the spot, you do it immediately without any delay.

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；基本上；总的来说
words.ex: On the whole, the movie was good.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这部电影不错。
words.en: You use on the whole to indicate that what you are saying is true in general but may not be true in every case, or that you are giving a general opinion or summary of something.

words.ex: He arrives on time every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都准时到达。
words.en: If something happens on time, it happens at the time that was planned.

words.tr: phrase. 彻底了结地；一劳永逸地
words.ex: He solved the problem once and for all.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底解决了这个问题。
words.en: If something is done once and for all, it is done completely and finally.

words.tr: phrase. 陆续地；一个接一个地
words.ex: The children left the room one after another.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一个接一个地离开了房间。
words.en: If things happen one after another, they happen in sequence, with little or no time in between.

words.ex: Hurry up, or else you'll miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会错过公交车。
words.en: Used to introduce the alternative that is likely or certain to happen if something does not happen or is not done.

words.tr: phrase. 越界的；禁止入内的
words.ex: The ball went out of bounds during the game.
words.ex_cn: 球在比赛中出了界。
words.en: If something is out of bounds, people are not allowed to do it, go to it, or use it.

words.tr: phrase. 失控的；无法控制的；失去控制的
words.ex: The car was out of control on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在结冰的路面上失去了控制。
words.en: If something is out of control, no one has any power over it.

words.ex: This phone is out of date.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了。
words.en: No longer fashionable or current; obsolete.

words.tr: phrase. 出于恐惧；由于害怕
words.ex: He stayed silent out of fear.
words.ex_cn: 他出于恐惧保持沉默。
words.en: Because of being afraid; motivated by fear.

words.tr: phrase. 够不到的；遥不可及的；无法获得的
words.ex: The apple is out of reach.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果够不着。
words.en: If something is out of reach, it is impossible to touch or obtain.

words.tr: phrase. /adv. 不在旺季的；不合时令的；反季节的；过季的
words.ex: The apples are out of season now.
words.ex_cn: 现在苹果不是应季水果。
words.en: Not available or not at the best time of year; not in season.

words.tr: phrase. 看不见；在视野以外
words.ex: The keys are out of sight under the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在沙发下面，看不见了。
words.en: If something is out of sight, it is too far away to be seen.

words.ex: It is out of the question to buy a new car now.
words.ex_cn: 现在买一辆新车是绝对不可能的。
words.en: If you say that something is out of the question, you are emphasizing that it is completely impossible or unacceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 失业的；没有工作的
words.ex: He is out of work after the factory closed.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭后，他失业了。
words.en: If someone is out of work, they do not have a job.

words.tr: phrase. 一次又一次地；反复地；不断地
words.ex: He practiced the song over and over again.
words.ex_cn: 他一遍又一遍地练习这首歌。
words.en: Repeatedly; many times.

words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe money to someone, they have lent it to you and you have not yet paid it back. You can also say that you owe someone a debt of gratitude if they have helped you in a way that you feel you should thank them for.

words.ex: He was late owing to the bus delay.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车晚点了。
words.en: You use owing to when you are introducing the reason for something.

words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.ex: I cannot part with my old watch.
words.ex_cn: 我无法放弃我的旧手表。
words.en: To give up possession or association with something or someone, often reluctantly.

words.ex: He wants to participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.ex: My grandfather passed away last year.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父去年去世了。
words.en: If someone passes away, they die.

words.ex: I saw a car pass by my house.
words.ex_cn: 我看到一辆车从我家旁边开过。
words.en: To move past or go past something or someone without stopping or without paying attention to them.

words.tr: phrase. 把……传给……；将……交给……；将……转达给……
words.ex: He will pass on the message to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他会把消息转告给他的朋友。
words.en: To transmit or transfer something to someone else.

words.ex: We will pay a visit to the museum tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天要去参观博物馆。
words.en: To go to see someone or something, especially for a short time.

words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请专心听老师讲课。
words.en: To focus one's mind or efforts on something or someone, especially in order to understand or learn.

words.ex: He will pay for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他将为这杯咖啡付款。
words.en: To give money in exchange for goods or services; to suffer the consequences of one's actions.

words.ex: He will persist in trying to learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他会坚持每天努力学习英语。
words.en: To continue to do something despite difficulties or opposition, in a way that can seem unreasonable.

words.ex: He tried to persuade her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If you persuade someone to do something, you cause them to do it by giving them good reasons for doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: phrase. 强调；着重于；把重点放在
words.ex: Schools should place emphasis on reading and writing.
words.ex_cn: 学校应该重视读写能力。
words.en: To give special importance or attention to something.

words.ex: He played a joke on his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他跟朋友开了个玩笑。
words.en: To play a joke on someone means to trick them in a humorous way.

words.ex: Exercise plays a role in keeping you healthy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼在保持健康方面起着作用。
words.en: To have a part or function in a particular situation or event.

words.tr: phrase. 起重要作用；扮演重要角色；发挥关键作用
words.ex: Teachers play an important role in children's education.
words.ex_cn: 教师在儿童教育中起着重要作用。
words.en: To have a significant effect or influence on something.

words.tr: phrase. 在……中起重要作用；在……中扮演重要角色
words.ex: Water plays an important part in keeping our body healthy.
words.ex_cn: 水在保持我们身体健康方面起着重要作用。
words.en: To have a significant role or effect in a particular situation or activity.

words.ex: There is plenty of food on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上有很多食物。
words.en: A large quantity or number; more than enough.

words.ex: From my point of view, this is the best choice.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，这是最好的选择。
words.en: A particular attitude or way of considering a matter.

words.ex: He will point out the mistake in the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他将指出这道数学题中的错误。
words.en: To direct someone's attention to a particular fact or detail.

words.ex: Pollution can pose a threat to our health.
words.ex_cn: 污染可能对我们的健康构成威胁。
words.en: To present a danger or risk to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 比起……更喜欢……；宁愿……而不……
words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you prefer one thing to another, you like the first thing better than the second.

words.ex: He prepares for the test every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上为考试做准备。
words.en: To make ready or get set for a future event or situation.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止头部受伤。
words.en: To prevent something means to stop it from happening or to stop someone from doing something.

words.ex: The school prohibits students from using phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If a law or someone in authority prohibits something, they forbid it or make it illegal.

words.tr: phrase. 证明是；结果是；被证实为
words.ex: The new method proves to be very helpful for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 新方法被证明对初学者非常有帮助。
words.en: To show that something is true or correct by providing evidence or argument.

words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

words.ex: He pulled up the weed from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他把杂草从花园里拔了出来。
words.en: To pull up means to bring something to a higher position or to stop moving.

words.tr: phrase. 推进；推动；继续向前；努力争取
words.ex: He will push forward with the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他将推进这个计划。
words.en: To continue doing something or making progress in a determined way, especially when facing difficulties.

words.ex: The new law will put an end to pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律将结束污染。
words.en: To cause something to stop or to finish something.

words.tr: phrase. 搁置一旁；保留；储存...备用
words.ex: He put aside his money for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存起来用于旅行。
words.en: To place something to one side; to save something for future use.

words.tr: phrase. 收起来；杀死；关进监狱；放弃
words.ex: He put away his toys after playing.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具收起来了。
words.en: To put something away means to place it in its proper storage location, to save or store it, to consume it, or to confine someone in prison.

words.tr: phrase. 提出（观点、理论等）；伸出；发挥；使长出（芽、叶等）
words.ex: He put forth a new idea at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To present or propose something for consideration; to exert or extend.

words.tr: phrase. 把…关进监狱；监禁；投入监狱
words.ex: The thief was put in prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 小偷因偷窃被关进了监狱。
words.en: To send someone to jail as a punishment.

words.tr: phrase. 实施；使生效；付诸实行
words.ex: The new rules will be put into effect next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规则将于下周一实施。
words.en: To cause something to start to apply or operate.

words.tr: phrase. 实施；付诸实践；把…应用到实践中
words.ex: He learned to put his new skills into practice at work.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了在工作中把新技能付诸实践。
words.en: To apply or implement something in a real situation.

words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
