words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 对…施加压力；逼迫；迫使
words.ex: They put pressure on him to finish the work quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他们给他施加压力，让他尽快完成工作。
words.en: To apply force or influence to someone or something in order to make them do something or to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: Quite a few students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 相当多的学生通过了考试。
words.en: You use quite a few to emphasize that you are referring to a considerable number of things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.ex: He reaches for the book on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他伸手去拿书架上的书。
words.en: To extend out an arm or hand in order to touch or grasp something; to strive to achieve or obtain something.

words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.ex: He will recover from the flu next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会从流感中康复。
words.en: To recover from something means to return to a normal state of health, mind, or strength after experiencing an illness, injury, or emotional distress.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细想；考虑；反思；带来不良影响
words.ex: He likes to reflect on his day before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡觉前反思自己的一天。
words.en: If you reflect on something, you think deeply about it.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr: phrase. 记得去做某事（指动作尚未发生）
words.ex: Remember to drink water every hour.
words.ex_cn: 记得每小时喝一次水。
words.en: To have the intention to do something in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 使想起；提醒（某人）想起；使回忆起
words.ex: This song reminds me of my childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌让我想起了我的童年。
words.en: If something reminds you of someone or something, it makes you think of them because they are similar in some way.

words.ex: The thief robbed him of his wallet.
words.ex_cn: 小偷抢走了他的钱包。
words.en: To deprive someone of something, typically in a violent or sudden manner.

words.ex: He runs a risk of failing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他有考试不及格的风险。
words.en: To do something that might result in loss, harm, or danger.

words.ex: I run across my old friend at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: To meet or find someone or something by chance.

words.ex: He will run for mayor next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将竞选市长。
words.en: To compete for a position or office in an election.

words.tr: phrase. 跑进；撞上；偶遇；陷入；达到
words.ex: The dog ran into the house.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑进了房子。
words.en: To meet someone or find something by chance; to experience something unexpectedly; to collide with something.

words.ex: We ran out of milk this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天早上牛奶喝完了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.tr: phrase. 碾过；溢出；匆匆浏览；超过（时间、数量等）
words.ex: The car ran over a small stone on the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碾过了路上的一块小石头。
words.en: To hit someone or something with a vehicle and drive over them; to quickly look through or read something; to overflow.

words.ex: My mom scolded me for coming home late.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈因为我回家晚而责备了我。
words.en: If you scold someone, you speak angrily to them because they have done something wrong.

words.ex: He is searching for his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他正在找他的钥匙。
words.en: To look for something carefully and thoroughly.

words.ex: I will see my brother off at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我会去机场为我哥哥送行。
words.en: To accompany someone to the point of departure, especially as a gesture of farewell.

words.tr: phrase. 务必确保；负责使…发生（或完成）
words.ex: See to it that the door is locked.
words.ex_cn: 确保门锁好了。
words.en: To make sure that something is done or happens.

words.tr: phrase. 负责处理某事；照料某事
words.ex: I will see to the homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我会在晚饭前处理作业。
words.en: To deal with or take care of a particular task or problem.

words.ex: He seeks for his lost keys in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里寻找他丢失的钥匙。
words.en: To try to find or obtain something by searching or asking.

words.ex: The concert tickets sold out in one hour.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的票在一小时内就卖光了。
words.en: To sell all of the available items or tickets for an event, so that there are no more left for people to buy.

words.tr: phrase. 派人去叫；派人去请；派人去取
words.ex: He will send for a doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会请医生过来。
words.en: To ask or order that someone or something be brought to you, especially by sending a message.

words.tr:
adj. 分开的；分离的；单独的；
v. 分离；隔离；
words.ex: They live in separate houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在分开的房子里。
words.en: To cause to move or be apart; to divide or keep apart.

words.tr: phrase. 树立一个好榜样；以身作则
words.ex: He sets a good example by arriving on time every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天准时到达，树立了良好的榜样。
words.en: To behave in a way that others should copy.

words.ex: He set about cleaning the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完早餐后开始打扫房间。
words.en: To start doing something, especially something that needs a lot of effort or time.

words.tr: phrase. 阐明；提出；陈列；出发；把…提前
words.ex: He set forth his ideas clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地提出了自己的想法。
words.en: To present or introduce something, such as an idea, plan, or argument, in a clear and detailed way.

words.ex: They set free the bird from the cage.
words.ex_cn: 他们把鸟从笼子里放了。
words.en: To release someone or something from confinement or restraint.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr: phrase. 定居；平静下来；专心于
words.ex: He wants to settle down with a family.
words.ex_cn: 他想安定下来组建家庭。
words.en: To settle down means to start living in a place where you intend to stay for a long time, usually after moving around a lot.

words.tr: phrase. 握手（表示问候、祝贺或达成协议）
words.ex: They shake hands after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他们在会议结束后握手。
words.en: To grasp someone's hand and move it up and down as a greeting or to signify agreement.

words.ex: I will share the book with my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我会和我的朋友分享这本书。
words.en: To give a portion of something to someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 带领参观；引导四处看看
words.ex: He will show around the visitors at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他将带参观者在学校里转转。
words.en: To lead someone on a tour of a place, showing them its features and facilities.

words.ex: He likes to show off his new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新自行车。
words.en: If someone shows off, they behave in a way that is intended to attract attention and impress people, often by displaying their abilities or possessions.

words.ex: He did not show up for class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有来上课。
words.en: If someone shows up, they arrive somewhere, especially unexpectedly or after they have been waiting a long time.

words.ex: The teacher singled out one student for praise.
words.ex_cn: 老师挑出一名学生进行表扬。
words.en: To choose someone or something from a group for special attention or treatment.

words.tr: phrase. 偷懒；懈怠；不认真工作
words.ex: He slack off when the teacher isn't looking.
words.ex_cn: 当老师没注意时，他偷懒。
words.en: To be lazy or to do something with less effort or energy than is required.

words.ex: So far, he has finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Up to the present moment; until now.

words.ex: Sooner or later, he will finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 迟早他会完成他的作业。
words.en: If you say that something will happen sooner or later, you mean that it will happen at some time in the future, even though it might take a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 说某人的坏话；诽谤
words.ex: He never speaks ill of his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他从不背后说同学的坏话。
words.en: To say bad things about someone or something, especially in a way that is unfair or unkind.

words.tr: phrase. 大声说；毫无顾虑地说出
words.ex: She decided to speak out about the unfair rule.
words.ex_cn: 她决定大声说出这个不公平的规定。
words.en: To express one's opinions openly and without fear, especially in a situation where it might be difficult or dangerous to do so.

words.tr: 专门研究，专攻；专门从事【动词短语】
words.ex: He specialises in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他专攻计算机科学。
words.en: To concentrate on and become expert in a particular subject or skill.

words.tr: phrase. 花费（时间、金钱等）做某事（in 可省略，常用于 spend time/money (in) doing something）
words.ex: He spends two hours in reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天花两个小时读书。
words.en: To use time or effort in a particular activity, especially one that is enjoyable or productive.

words.ex: He spends money on books.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱买书。
words.en: To spend means to use money to buy or pay for something, or to use time or energy in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；遵守；袖手旁观；准备行动
words.ex: I will stand by you when you face difficulties.
words.ex_cn: 当你遇到困难时，我会支持你。
words.en: To be ready to support or act if needed; to wait in a state of readiness.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；象征；支持；容忍
words.ex: The letter A stands for apple.
words.ex_cn: 字母A代表苹果。
words.en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

words.ex: Fear can stand in the way of success.
words.ex_cn: 恐惧会阻碍成功。
words.en: To prevent something from happening or someone from doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 独立自主；自立；不依赖他人
words.ex: He wants to stand on his own feet and not depend on his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他想自立，不再依赖父母。
words.en: To be independent and able to take care of oneself without needing help from others.

words.tr: phrase. 引人注目；突出；出色
words.ex: Her red hat makes her stand out in the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 她的红帽子让她在人群中很显眼。
words.en: To be very noticeable or obvious, especially in comparison to others.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；捍卫；为…挺身而出
words.ex: He will stand up for his friend when others are mean.
words.ex_cn: 当别人对他的朋友刻薄时，他会为朋友挺身而出。
words.en: To support or defend someone or something.

words.ex: He stares at the clock every minute.
words.ex_cn: 他每分钟都盯着时钟看。
words.en: To look at someone or something for a long time with the eyes wide open, especially when surprised, angry, or because you are thinking.

words.tr: phrase. 饿死；因饥饿而死亡
words.ex: The old man starved to death because no one gave him food.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人因为没人给他食物而饿死了。
words.en: To die from lack of food.

words.ex: He stays up late to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜完成作业。
words.en: To remain awake and active until late at night.

words.ex: He solved the math problem step by step.
words.ex_cn: 他一步一步地解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Proceeding gradually from one stage to the next.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；坚持；紧跟；忠于
words.ex: The glue will stick the paper to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会把纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.

words.ex: He stopped doing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他停止做作业了。
words.en: To cease to do a particular activity or action.

words.tr: phrase. 停下来去做某事（指停止当前的事，转而去做另一件事）
words.ex: He stops to drink water after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完步后停下来喝水。
words.en: To pause an activity in order to do something else.

words.tr: phrase. 替代某物；用……代替某物
words.ex_cn: 他今天将代替老师。
words.en: To use something or someone instead of another thing or person.

words.ex: He likes fruits such as apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果和香蕉这样的水果。
words.en: Used to introduce examples of something that has been mentioned.

words.ex: He suffers from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他患了重感冒。
words.en: If you suffer from an illness or from a medical condition, you are badly affected by it.

words.ex: The store supplies with fresh water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 商店每天早上提供新鲜的水。
words.en: To provide someone with something they need.

words.tr: 短语，表示‘被怀疑犯有（某罪行或不当行为）’，常用于被动语态，如 be suspected of
words.ex: He is suspected of stealing the money.
words.ex_cn: 他被怀疑偷了钱。
words.en: To believe that someone is likely to be guilty of a crime or wrongdoing.

words.tr: phrase. 同情，怜悯：对他人的困境、痛苦或不幸感到理解和同情。; 赞同，支持：对某人的观点、立场或行为表示理解...
words.ex: I sympathize with people who are tired.
words.ex_cn: 我同情那些感到疲惫的人。
words.en: If you sympathize with someone who is in a bad situation, you feel sorry for them and show this in the way you behave towards them.

words.tr: phrase. 使……措手不及；出其不意地袭击或惊吓
words.ex: The test results took her by surprise.
words.ex_cn: 测试结果让她大吃一惊。
words.en: To cause someone to feel surprised because they were not expecting something.

words.tr: phrase. 牵着……的手；引导，带领（某人）
words.ex: He takes her by the hand and walks to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他牵着她的手走向公园。
words.en: Lead or guide someone gently or supportively, especially in a teaching or caring manner.

words.tr: 短语. 以……为例；拿……来说
words.ex: Many animals are smart; take dogs for example.
words.ex_cn: 许多动物都很聪明；以狗为例。
words.en: To mention someone or something as an illustration or instance of what is being discussed.

words.tr: phrase. 认为…理所当然；想当然
words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or accept it as normal without thinking about it.

words.ex: We must take the weather into consideration before planning the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在计划旅行之前，我们必须把天气考虑进去。
words.en: To think about and include something when making a decision or judgment.

words.ex: He decided to take a chance and apply for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他决定冒险申请这份工作。
words.en: To do something that involves risk or uncertainty, often with the hope of success.

words.ex: Take a look at this picture.
words.ex_cn: 看一下这张图片。
words.en: To examine or inspect something briefly.

words.ex: He took a risk and started his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他冒了一个险，开了自己的公司。
words.en: To do something that involves the possibility of danger, loss, or failure.

words.tr: phrase. （非正式）兜风；转一圈；试用一下
words.ex: Let me take a spin on the bike.
words.ex_cn: 让我骑一下这辆自行车。
words.en: To go for a short drive or ride, especially for pleasure.

words.ex: They will take a trip to the beach next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周要去海边旅行。
words.en: Go on a journey or excursion, typically for pleasure or business.

words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.ex: He takes after his father in looks.
words.ex_cn: 他在长相上像他父亲。
words.en: If you take after a member of your family, you resemble them in your appearance, your behaviour, or your character.

words.ex: He takes away the toys after playtime.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具拿走。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to subtract a number or amount from another.

words.tr: phrase. 照顾；照料；处理；应付
words.ex: She takes care of her little brother after school.
words.ex_cn: 她放学后照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To look after someone or something; to deal with something.

words.ex: He will take charge of the project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将负责这个项目。
words.en: To assume control or responsibility over something.

words.tr: phrase. 鼓起勇气；振作精神
words.ex: He took courage and spoke to the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他鼓起勇气，向人群讲话。
words.en: If you take courage, you make yourself brave enough to do something that you are afraid of.

words.tr: phrase. 放轻松；别紧张；悠着点
words.ex: Take it easy, the test is not hard.
words.ex_cn: 别紧张，考试不难。
words.en: To relax and not do anything too energetic or stressful.

words.tr: phrase. 认真对待某事；严肃看待某事
words.ex: You should take it seriously when the teacher gives advice.
words.ex_cn: 当老师给出建议时，你应该认真对待。
words.en: To consider something as important and deserving of attention and effort.

words.tr: phrase. v. 告别；辞别；离开
words.ex: He took leave of his friends before leaving town.
words.ex_cn: 他离开镇子前跟朋友们告别了。
words.en: To say goodbye to someone or to depart from a place.

words.tr: phrase. 采取措施以（做某事）
words.ex: The government takes measures to reduce pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府采取措施减少污染。
words.en: To take measures to do something means to do something in order to achieve a particular result or to deal with a problem.

words.ex: Please take note of the time.
words.ex_cn: 请记下时间。
words.en: To pay attention to something or someone because you think they are important.

words.ex: He did not take notice of the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他没有注意到那个警告标志。
words.en: To become aware of something or someone, especially by seeing or hearing them.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr: phrase. 生气；不悦；被冒犯：对他人的言行感到生气或不悦，被冒犯。
words.ex: He took offense when she laughed at his joke.
words.ex_cn: 当她笑他的笑话时，他感到被冒犯了。
words.en: To feel upset or insulted by something said or done.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 慢慢来；不着急；从容不迫地做某事
words.ex: He takes his time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢做作业，不着急。
words.en: To use as much time as one needs, without hurrying.

words.tr: phrase. 下苦功；费心尽力；认真努力做某事
words.ex: He takes pains to help his classmates with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他费尽心思帮助同学做作业。
words.en: If you take pains to do something or go to great pains to do something, you try hard to do it, because you think it is important to do it.

words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.tr: phrase. 采取措施；采取步骤
words.ex: We must take steps to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须采取措施保护环境。
words.en: To take steps means to begin a course of action intended to achieve a particular result.

words.tr: 短语动词。在……方面主动采取行动；带头做某事
words.ex: He takes the initiative in cleaning the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他主动打扫教室。
words.en: Be the first to act or make a decision in a situation, taking responsibility for starting something.

words.ex: Tom takes the lead in the race.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆在比赛中领先。
words.en: To be in the leading position in a competition, race, or any activity.

words.ex: Computers can take the place of typewriters.
words.ex_cn: 计算机可以取代打字机。
words.en: To take the place of something or someone means to replace them or to be used instead of them.

words.tr: phrase. 不辞辛劳地做某事；特意费心去做某事
words.ex: He takes the trouble to help his classmates every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都费心帮助同学。
words.en: If you take the trouble to do something, you make the effort to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 开始从事；喜欢；形成...的习惯
words.ex: He took to swimming every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他开始每天早上游泳来保持健康。
words.en: To begin to like someone or something; to start doing something as a habit or regular activity.

words.ex: The children take turns to play with the toy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们轮流玩这个玩具。
words.en: If people take turns doing something, they do it one after the other to ensure that each person has an equal opportunity to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.tr: phrase. 详细讨论；商量；说服（某人）
words.ex: They talk over their problems every night.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上一起讨论他们的问题。
words.en: To discuss something thoroughly or at length.

words.ex: He talked his friend into going to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他说服他的朋友去参加了派对。
words.en: To persuade someone to do something, especially something they might not want to do.

words.tr: phrase. 比以往任何时候都（用于强调程度或变化）
words.ex: He works harder than ever before.
words.ex_cn: 他比以往任何时候都更努力。
words.en: Used to emphasize that a situation is more extreme or intense now compared to any previous time.

words.ex: Thanks to his help, I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 多亏了他的帮助，我通过了考试。
words.en: used to say that something good has happened because of someone or something

words.ex: He is late, that is to say, he will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，也就是说，他会错过公交车。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that makes the meaning of something clearer or gives more information

words.ex: They think highly of their teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他们非常尊敬他们的老师。
words.en: To have a very good opinion of someone or something; to regard someone or something with great respect or admiration.

words.tr: phrase. 轻视；不重视；认为…没什么了不起
words.ex: He think little of the plan because it seems too risky.
words.ex_cn: 他不太看重这个计划，因为它看起来风险太大。
words.en: To consider something as unimportant or not worthy of attention.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑；重新考虑
words.ex: I need time to think over your offer.
words.ex_cn: 我需要时间考虑你的提议。
words.en: To consider carefully before making a decision.

words.tr: phrase. 三思而行；仔细考虑后再做决定
words.ex: He thinks twice before he buys a car.
words.ex_cn: 他在买车之前会三思。
words.en: To consider something more carefully before making a decision.

words.tr: phrase. 想出；构思出（主意、计划等）
words.ex: He can think up new ideas very fast.
words.ex_cn: 他能很快想出新点子。
words.en: To invent or devise something.

words.tr: phrase. 投身于；全心投入（某活动或事业）
words.ex: He threw himself into learning English.
words.ex_cn: 他全身心投入到英语学习中。
words.en: To start doing something with a lot of energy and enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. 一次又一次；屡次；反复地
words.ex: He fails time after time, but he never gives up.
words.ex_cn: 他一次又一次失败，但他从不放弃。
words.en: If you say that something happens time after time, you mean that it happens often and usually that it is annoying or that it causes problems.

words.tr: 短语. 坦白说；老实讲（用于引出坦率或直率的意见）
words.ex: To be frank with you, I don't like this plan.
words.ex_cn: 老实跟你说，我不喜欢这个计划。
words.en: Used to indicate that the speaker is about to express a candid opinion or fact.

words.ex: To some extent, he likes the new job.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他喜欢这份新工作。
words.en: To some extent means to a certain degree or in a certain measure, but not completely.

words.ex: She wants to try on the new dress.
words.ex_cn: 她想试穿那条新裙子。
words.en: To put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits or if you like it.

words.tr: phrase. 尽力而为；竭尽全力
words.ex: I will try my best to finish the homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 我会尽力按时完成作业。
words.en: To make the greatest possible effort to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 对…充耳不闻；故意不理睬
words.ex: He always turns a deaf ear to my advice.
words.ex_cn: 他总是对我的建议充耳不闻。
words.en: To ignore or refuse to listen to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 使停止往前；往回走
words.ex: He turned back when he saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到狗时，他往回走了。
words.en: To go back in the direction you have come from, or to make someone or something do this.

words.ex: Please turn down the volume, it's too loud.
words.ex_cn: 请把音量调低，太大声了。
words.en: To refuse or reject an offer or request; to reduce the volume, temperature, or intensity of something.

words.ex: The caterpillar turns into a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成了一只蝴蝶。
words.en: To change or develop into something different.

words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前请关灯。
words.en: If you turn off a device or machine, you stop it from operating by pressing a button or moving a switch.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.tr: phrase. 回到……以获取……；重返……寻求……
words.ex: He will return to the store for his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他会回到商店拿他的钥匙。
words.en: Go back to a place or state in order to seek something, such as help, information, or comfort.

words.tr: phrase. 突然出现；重新露面；调大
words.ex: He didn't turn up to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他没有出席会议。
words.en: To arrive or appear somewhere, often unexpectedly; to increase the volume or intensity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 在任何情况下都不；决不
words.ex: Under no circumstances will I lie to you.
words.ex_cn: 我绝不会对你撒谎。
words.en: In no situation or for no reason.

words.tr: phrase. 受……的控制；在……的管理之下
words.ex: The robot is under the control of the operator.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人由操作员控制。
words.en: Being managed, directed, or governed by someone or something, with limited freedom to act independently.

words.ex: The project is under way.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: If an activity is under way, it has already started.

words.tr: phrase. 多达；直到；在于…；能胜任
words.ex: The box can hold up to ten books.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子最多能放十本书。
words.en: used to say that something is the responsibility of someone or that someone has the ability to decide something

words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: To remain in a place until a particular time or until something else happens.

words.tr: phrase. 服侍；招待；焦急地等待
words.ex: The waitress waits on customers at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员在晚餐时服侍顾客。
words.en: To serve food and drink, especially to customers in a restaurant or at a table; to wait for something to happen or for someone to arrive.

words.ex: I wake up at seven every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点醒来。
words.en: To stop sleeping and become conscious, or to make someone stop sleeping.

words.tr: v. 警告；告诫；提醒注意；
words.ex: The teacher warned the students not to be late.
words.ex_cn: 老师警告学生不要迟到。
words.en: If you warn someone about something such as a possible danger or problem, you tell them about it so that they are aware of it.

words.ex: Watch out for the falling tree!
words.ex_cn: 小心掉下来的树！
words.en: To be careful or cautious, especially in order to avoid danger.

words.tr: phrase. 用坏；穿破；（使）筋疲力尽；耗尽
words.ex: He wore out his shoes after running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步，把鞋子磨坏了。
words.en: To wear out means to make something old and damaged because it has been used a lot, or to make someone extremely tired.

words.tr: phrase. 富裕的；境况良好的
words.ex: They are well off because they own a big house and a car.
words.ex_cn: 他们很富裕，因为他们有一栋大房子和一辆车。
words.en: Having a lot of money or owning a lot of things.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.ex_cn: 她想更深入了解科学。
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.ex: He wiped out the board with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布把板擦掉了。
words.en: To completely destroy, remove, or eliminate something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 轻松地；毫不费力地
words.ex: He solves math problems with ease.
words.ex_cn: 他轻松地解决数学问题。
words.en: If you do something with ease, you do it easily, without difficulty.

words.ex: He spoke with regard to the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他谈到了新规定。
words.en: Used to introduce the subject that one is going to talk or write about.

words.tr: 短语. 在伸手可及的范围内；能够得到的
words.ex: The water is within reach.
words.ex_cn: 水在伸手可及的地方。
words.en: If something is within reach, it is near enough for you to touch or get it easily.

words.tr: phrase. 一定；必定；无一例外
words.ex: He wakes up at 6 a.m. without fail.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上六点准时起床。
words.en: If you do something without fail, you always do it.

words.ex: The stars stretch out without limit.
words.ex_cn: 星星无限延伸。
words.en: Having no restrictions or bounds; unlimited.

words.tr: phrase. 逐字地；一字一句地
words.ex: He reads word by word.
words.ex_cn: 他逐字阅读。
words.en: In a manner that involves dealing with each word individually and in sequence.

words.tr: phrase. 从事于…；继续工作；设法说服；影响
words.ex: He works on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都做家庭作业。
words.en: To spend time repairing or improving something.

words.tr: phrase. 逐步前进；努力获得（某地位或成就）；靠工作谋生或支付费用
words.ex: He works his way up the ladder at his job.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中一步步晋升。
words.en: To make progress or achieve something gradually, especially through hard work.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.ex: I would rather stay home than go out in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 我宁愿待在家里也不愿在雨中出去。
words.en: If you say that you would rather do something or you'd rather do it, you mean that you would prefer to do it. If you say that you would rather not do something, you mean that you do not want to do it.

words.ex: Please write down your name.
words.ex_cn: 请写下你的名字。
words.en: To record something in writing.

words.ex: I write to my friend every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周给我的朋友写信。
words.en: Send a letter, email, or message to someone, especially to communicate information or ask for something.

words.ex: He yields to his brother when they argue.
words.ex_cn: 当他们争吵时，他让着弟弟。
words.en: To give way to arguments, demands, or pressure.
